decisions.reason: As the current Google Analytics standard, GA4 still offers clear market relevance and the plugin is inexpensive for a software consultancy to keep available while demand continues to develop.
Because Universal Analytics has been phased out, the product’s downside is largely resolved and keeping it on the market offers little option value compared with reallocating effort elsewhere.
A retail system interface plugin is a niche but potentially useful integration option whose commercial value may still be unfolding, so it is worth keeping while maintenance costs remain manageable.

An SEO support service for shop relaunches fits the firm’s core consultancy business, appears more deliberately positioned, and can stay on the market at low cost while generating project opportunities.
